The '''Icetromper Wastes''' was a tundra located in the [[Whiterock Wastes]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|battle]] for control of Hoth during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]], the Icetromper Wastes were primarily under [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] control, but the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] made advances on the area and pushed back most Republic forces to [[Aurek Base]] just to the north.
